sentences.text:
This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER

This is first bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C for grant of regular bail in connection with crime No.28/2024 dated : not mentioned, registered at P.S. - Bilpank District - Ratlam for offences punishable under Sections 376, 506, 34 of IPC.
2. As per prosecution case, it is alleged that on 24/12/2023, the prosecutrix alongwith her husband had gone to her aunty's house.
The other guests had also came.
A call was made by one Roopsingh and she was called in the new house of her aunty(mausi).

When the prosecutrix went there,
Roopsingh had already gone and the present applicant was present there.
It is alleged that he pulled her inside the room and committed rape.
Since, she was terrified, therefore, she did not lodged the report.

The FIR was registered on 16/1/2024.
3.
Counsel for the applicant submits that the prosecutrix is a major married woman and she was in love relationship with the present applicant.
There is a delay of about 25 days in lodging the FIR.
The applicant is in jail since 7/3/2024.

The investigation has been completed, charge-sheet has been Kantilal vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 15 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/155962635/
1 filed.
4. Counsel for the State opposes the prayer for grant of bail.

entities.text: Kantilal vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. After hearing learned counsel for the parties and considering the statement of the prosecutrix recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C and the delay in lodging the FIR and also the fact that there are call details between the applicant and the prosecutrix, I am of the view that prima facie case is made out for grant of bail.

6. It is directed that applicant Kantilal shall be released from custody upon furnishing a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand Only) with one surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Ld. Court below.
7. A typed copy of this order is being forwarded to the Office of the Advocate General, on their email address, for intimation to the Police Station concerned.
The office is requested to forward a copy of this order to the Ld. Court below.
8. With the aforesaid, the application is allowed and disposed off.
Cc as per rules.
(VIJAY KUMAR SHUKLA) JUDGE PK Kantilal vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 15 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/155962635/
